name: Thessaly Vane
line: The Society's patron handler. Composed, precise, and never early — except when it matters.

name: Hesper Brack
line: One rule, enforced. Whatever you are outside, in her tavern you're a customer.

name: Inspector Renna Laine
line: Overworked, ink-stained, and short of constables. She hired the Society first, and trusts them exactly as far as their record goes.

name: Corrigan Fels
line: The man you talk to when something needs moving. He doesn't hold grudges. He keeps accounts.

name: Dace Rennick
line: Knows everyone, owes everyone, is owed by everyone. His cigar is never finished.

name: Dr. Isavel Crane
line: Her research team went into the Deep Wild six months ago and stopped answering. She hasn't slept well since.

name: Gideon Marlow
line: Operations director, old soldier, true believer in the Engine — and lately, a man asking his board uncomfortable questions.
